name: Gasteiger & Prettner (2020), robot-worker substitution mu = 0.4
description: Sensitivity case from p.24 of the working paper: mu = 0.4 (elasticity of substitution 1.67), all other parameters as in the base model. The paper reports that the welfare-maximising robot tax rises to 0.57. Only a parameter changes; no equation is touched.

source.label: Gasteiger & Prettner (2020), Automation, Stagnation, and the Implications of a Robot Tax, ECON WPS 02/2020, TU Wien, §5 p.24: sensitivity case mu = 0.4
source.note: Alternative robot-worker substitution parameter used by the authors to show how the optimal tax moves.

tests.name: p.24: welfare-maximising tau = 0.57 ± 0.01 with mu = 0.4 — steady-state utility grid maximum is at tau = 0.58 (0.01 grid)
